patch.value: GH-1622: investigate pm-presets SDK-loading fault blocking daily release

Auto Release run 40813895480 on 2026-10-29 stops at Sentry PM-CLI-3Q. Two SimulationRefusal sdk_unavailable events originate in the pm-presets package SDK loader on pm-cli 2026.10.25. Investigate package resolution and refusal classification without clearing the alert or bypassing release gates before verification.

Identify and verify the package SDK-loading cause; repair in the owning package and verify the installed consumer; resolve the Sentry issue only with remediation evidence; run the ordinary release gates and preserve one automatic cut per UTC day
